name: Xciel XCZ1 iPad mini 4
removable: No (certificate: the iPad shall not be removed from the aluminium case)
summary: The Xciel XCZ1 iPad mini 4 is a flameproof (Ex d) case for the iPad mini 4, certified for Zone 1 under ATEX and IECEx. The tablet inside is a standard iPad mini 4 running iPadOS 15, so it works with the same apps and device management. It has been discontinued; the Xciel XCZ1 iPad mini 5 replaces it.

atex.marking: II 2G Ex db IIC T5 Gb
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 2 (2023-06-22), checked 2026-10-25; ATEX not found

safety.conditions: The iPad Mini shall not be removed from the aluminium case. The iPad shall not be charged when hazardous atmospheres are present. Resellers, end users and Xciel are not allowed to repair the flameproof joints. The cover bolts should not be removed; they may only be replaced with identical ones (A2 stainless M5x0.8x8 mm Torx head, or pan head if Torx is not available, tensile strength at least 500 MPa, torque 5.9 N.m). After recharging, inspect the plug threads and female threads, install the power plug with all threads fully engaged and tighten the set screw (M4 x 0.70 mm A2-70 cup point) with the tool provided, checking it sits in the groove of the plug head. Rubber bumpers must be fitted at all times and inspected before each use.
safety.peripherals: Lightning charging plug with set screw must be fully engaged and tightened; charge only outside the hazardous area
safety.certifiedAccessories: Options listed (magnet mount, locking system, touch pen, ballistic nylon case, nylon X strap, hard shell case); Ex rating of accessories not stated

specs.batteryLife: Up to 10 hours web or video on Wi-Fi
specs.docking: USB-C hubs and docks; Smart Connector or magnetic keyboard accessories where the iPad has them. Not usable through sealed Ex cases except the USB-C or Lightning charging port where the case exposes it.

specs.keys: Top (sleep/wake) button, volume buttons, Home button with Touch ID; no programmable hardware key
